name: GS Holdings Corp.
summary: GS Holdings Corp. is a dynamic conglomerate with extensive operations spanning the energy, retail, and construction sectors, both within South Korea and across international markets. The company's robust energy division encompasses the management of co-generation plants and district heating and cooling networks, alongside natural gas distribution. It generates and supplies electricity, harnessing clean fuels like natural gas and bioenergy, and also participates in coal-fired thermal power. Its interests extend to trading petroleum products, petrochemicals, base oils, and lubricants. Furthermore, GS Holdings is involved in renewable energy initiatives, including the development and operation of wind power facilities and their transmission infrastructure, bioenergy provision, the maritime transport of liquefied petroleum gas and propylene, the production of reclaimed metals, and upstream oil and gas exploration and production activities. In the retail sphere, the corporation operates prominent brands such as GS25 convenience stores, GS Supermarkets, Watsons health and beauty outlets, and the Parnas Hotels chain. Beyond its principal businesses, GS Holdings provides an array of services. These include media development, content creation, advertising, point-of-purchase (POP) solutions, and mobile coupons. It is also active in TV home shopping, mobile commerce, and global trade, covering import/export and cross-border transactions. The company's logistics arm offers comprehensive transport and storage solutions for a wide range of commodities, from steel and metals to petrochemicals, cement, mechanical goods, industrial facilities, and bituminous coal. Additionally, it oversees the management of professional sports teams, specifically a football club and a volleyball team. Its construction and engineering segment undertakes projects in architecture, civil engineering, housing development, industrial plants, environmental solutions, and power plant infrastructure. The company also delivers specialized operation and maintenance services to the oil, gas, petrochemical, power generation, and environmental sectors, and provides telecommunication services. Rounding out its diverse portfolio, GS Holdings manages the Elysian resort, featuring condominiums, a golf course, and a ski slope. Founded in 2004, GS Holdings Corp. maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
